headline: Owner & Operator at Eleanor's Tavern | Hospitality | Astoria, Queens
summary: Owner and operator of Eleanor's Tavern, an American tavern in Astoria, Queens, serving the neighborhood since 2015. B.S. in Hospitality from Empire State Hospitality Institute; culinary training at the New England Culinary Institute. Two decades in NYC restaurants before opening my own. Focused on consistent food, a great team, and being a fixture of the community.
